review:
Deadwood xNudge is a 5x4 western where the four-row Hunter xNudge Wild can land on any reel and always nudges into view, adding +1 to its multiplier per nudge. Two sheriff badges trigger Shoot Out, which turns every low card symbol on the middle reels wild.

Three scatters let you choose between eight Hunter Spins, with at least one Hunter Wild every spin, and the more volatile Gunslinger Spins. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 13,950x cap and a 40% hit rate.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
